fields.why: Mandate effects are estimated in three age groups and the Discussion compares them ('less of a decline in this age group, compared with that of other adults'; 'might affect age groups differently').
Age (18-39, 40-64, >=65) is the only SPD; the periods relative to mandate implementation are not SPD groups.

Each age group's coefficients are tested against its own reference period (a non-SPD contrast within SPD levels, rule 6), and no interaction or test across age groups is reported, so the cross-age claim rests on values set side by side.

brief_issues: Rule 6 says a non-SPD contrast run within each SPD level makes no entry by itself; it could say outright that when the article then compares those within-level effects across 3+ SPD groups without a test, the entry is side by side (as here).
